PROFILE.background: Mateo moved to the UK from Poland in 2004 to join family members who had settled in Bristol. He started as a hotel receptionist while studying hospitality management part-time, gradually working his way up through various roles over 18 years.
PROFILE.goals: To improve operational efficiency across the hotel chain's Bristol properties while maintaining high guest satisfaction scores. Currently working on implementing a new digital check-in system.
PROFILE.communication_style: Direct and practical, values efficiency in communication. Prefers clear, actionable information and can become frustrated with overly complex explanations.
